note: Survey of the street Quang Trung, Vũng Tàu (the street of the Front Beach), 2026-11-14. The rows go from the SOUTH end (Trương Công Định / Hạ Long, number 2) to the NORTH end (Trần Phú, number 40): first the side of the town (east, the only side with buildings and numbers, all even), then the side of the sea (west: the park, the walks, the beach). from_north_m and from_south_m: the part of the street that the lot takes, in m along the street (the way of OpenStreetMap, 1136 m); at: [lat, lon] of the middle of its front. width_m: the frontage on Quang Trung; depth_m: the depth of the building; setback_m: from the back of the sidewalk to the front wall. marks: where each value comes from: OSM (OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), ML (Microsoft building footprints, ODbL), PHOTO n (a photo of `sources.photos`), WEB (a page of `sources.pages`), GUESS. A value with no mark is a description from the photos named in sources. The names of businesses are facts of the survey only. type: the type of building proposed for the rules (docs/plans/0018-quang-trung-street.md). house: what the rules of World.Town.House take from the row (a row with no `house` is not a house of those rules). The photos are not in the repository: 6 of them have all rights reserved (w01 to w03, f01 to f03) and were only read.

rows.family: colonial style (the Grand Hôtel of the French time, rebuilt)
rows.colour: pale yellow walls, orange-ochre pilasters and cornice, a brown band at the first floor, dark green iron rails
rows.ground: a low ground floor of rooms with small windows between piers; no shop; a bed of cycads behind a low stone wall, the name of the hotel on a boulder at the corner
rows.balcony: a recessed balcony in each bay on the two upper floors, iron rails; about 9 bays of 4 m on Quang Trung
rows.roof: a cornice and a parapet; behind it a low hipped roof of yellow tiles
rows.notes: From Nguyễn Trãi to the fore court of the hotel. The street signs of the corner read Quang Trung and Nguyễn Trãi.

marks.storeys: PHOTO d01

rows.name: Grand Hotel Vũng Tàu, the fore court and the main block
rows.colour: pale yellow, ochre pilasters, red letters GRAND HOTEL at the eaves
rows.ground: a fore court for cars round a circle, behind a fence of iron between piers with lanterns; a porch for cars at the door; a small gate house with a red tile roof
rows.balcony: balconies with iron rails between pilasters on the two upper floors
rows.roof: hipped roof of yellow tiles with a pediment
rows.notes: At the corner of Nguyễn Du. The main block (OSM way 118950627, addr 2 Nguyễn Du, 36 x 25 m) stands 51 m from the axis of the road behind the court; big Terminalia trees on the sidewalk. OSM way 791795133 is the outline of the whole hotel (88.6 m on Quang Trung).

marks.storeys: PHOTO c11

rows.name: Nhà thiếu nhi tỉnh Bà Rịa - Vũng Tàu (the House of Children of the province)
rows.colour: cream with teal green bands and window frames
rows.ground: a yard behind a fence and a gate with an arch; a wide flight of stairs up to the first floor; a hall on the right
rows.balcony: open galleries with rails on each floor
rows.roof: flat; a small round tower with a cone; the name in red letters on the roof edge
rows.notes: The building (OSM way 791795151, 64 m wide) is 31 m back from the axis of the road, behind its yard; a swimming pool (OSM way 220753344) is on the north side.
sources: PHOTO c10 (the gate with an arch seen over the median)

marks.storeys: PHOTO c13 (3, a 4th on a part)

rows.use: not known (OSM: a fast food that is no more; next to the pool of the House of Children)
rows.ground: not known; the 2021 aerial shows a blue roof or awning along the street
rows.roof: not known (a blue metal roof or awning in 2021)
rows.notes: A long narrow block at the corner of Thống Nhất, round at its north-west corner. Not seen in a photo at street level: its storeys, its use and its colour are not known.

rows.name: Vung Tau Ship (company office)
rows.ground: not known
rows.roof: not known
rows.notes: Between the end of Lê Lợi and Thống Nhất; the State Treasury (Kho bạc Nhà nước Vũng Tàu, OSM way 118946689) is behind it on Thống Nhất. Not seen in a photo: its storeys are a guess.

marks.storeys: GUESS

rows.name: OSC Việt Nam (the tourism company of the oil industry, 2 Lê Lợi): a villa in a yard
rows.colour: yellow walls, white frames, red tile roof
rows.ground: a yard behind a fence of iron between piers, a gate with a flat canopy that carries the name; coconut palms in the yard
rows.balcony: arched windows and a loggia on the first floor
rows.roof: hipped roof of red tiles
rows.notes: The yard is on Lê Lợi, across its junction with Quang Trung, at the south tip of the park Tam Giác: it is seen from Quang Trung, but its address is on Lê Lợi and it has no front on Quang Trung (width_m is the width of the junction). The villa: OSM way 237097609, a rectangle of 21 x 12 m. The Mường Thanh hotel (9 Thống Nhất, about 9 storeys, white) stands behind.

marks.storeys: PHOTO c05

rows.name: Công viên Tam Giác (the Triangle park)
rows.ground: a paved square with sculptures along the street, lawns, paths, big trees
rows.notes: Between Ba Cu and Lê Lợi: no building on the street for 225 m. The Pacific Hotel (4 Lê Lợi) is behind the park, 65 m from the street.

rows.name: Nhà truyền thống cách mạng (the house of the traditions of the revolution, 1 Ba Cu), in its park
rows.colour: cream walls, grey-blue shutters and frames, orange-red tile roof
rows.ground: a villa in a park: a lawn of grass pavers with old Terminalia trees and clipped bushes; no fence on the street in 2014
rows.balcony: tall windows with shutters, a band between the floors; no balcony
rows.roof: hipped roof of tiles
rows.notes: The villa (OSM way 119008640, 25.5 x 18.7 m) is 61 m from the axis of the road. The park (OSM way 220753335) takes the whole block from Lê Quý Đôn to Ba Cu (the press calls it the park of the street Lê Quý Đôn).
sources: WEB plo.vn 2020 (the park of Lê Quý Đôn)

marks.storeys: PHOTO c14

rows.name: Rex Hotel (1 Lê Quý Đôn), behind its garden
rows.family: large hotel (a slab of the 1970s-1990s, renewed)
rows.colour: white and cream; long bands of balconies; a red REX sign on the roof
rows.ground: a garden of old trees on the street (OSM: wood), a pool and a low pavilion with a tile roof of Chinese style in the garden; the lobby is on the side of Lê Quý Đôn
rows.balcony: a balcony for each room, in long bands on every floor
rows.roof: flat, with the sign and a tall block for the lifts
rows.notes: The main block in OpenStreetMap (way 119008631) is a rectangle of 32 x 24 m, 87 m from the axis of the road; the Microsoft footprint 300, with the wings, is 57 x 55 m and starts 65 m from the axis. A low wing of 3 storeys (yellow and brown) is by the pool. A low building (Microsoft footprint 41: 33 x 10 m) stands on the street between the Royal Hotel and the garden: not identified.
sources: PHOTO w02, w03 (the hotel from its pool)
PHOTO c06 (2014: the hotel over the trees)

marks.storeys: PHOTO w02 (9 on the main block)

rows.name: Royal Hotel (before: Canadian Hotel)
rows.colour: cream yellow, darker bands; green letters of the sign
rows.ground: a lobby behind a porch of four square columns with a flat canopy; a cafe with a terrace under parasols at the south end (the "360°" cafe) and a restaurant at the north end; a fore court of about 8 m with frangipani trees
rows.balcony: a balcony along the whole front on the two upper floors, dark iron rails; 9 bays of about 4 m and a plain end block
rows.roof: flat; the name in big letters on a frame on the roof, flag poles
rows.notes: At the corner of Hoàng Diệu. The plan is an L round a pool (OSM: 51 m deep in all); the block on the street is about 13 m deep. The Microsoft footprint gives 41 m of frontage.

rows.name: empty land (grass), a part of the land of Lam Sơn
rows.ground: a wall or a fence of metal sheets on the street (not seen)
rows.notes: From Lê Ngọc Hân to Hoàng Diệu: 13,600 m² of grass in OpenStreetMap. In 2014 a big wheel (a fair) stood about here (PHOTO d13). The press writes of a project of towers and hotels of the BRG group on about 11 ha of Lam Sơn (not started here).

rows.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Vũng Tàu (in construction, the builder is DICcons); before: villas of OSC Việt Nam
rows.colour: concrete under green nets in March 2024; the finished colour is not known
rows.ground: a site fence with printed boards; casuarina trees between the fence and the sidewalk
rows.roof: not known (a tower crane on the roof in 2024)
rows.notes: The last lot at the north end, where the street turns into Trần Phú, between Thành Thái and Lê Ngọc Hân: 8,500 m² (OSM: landuse=construction "DIC Holdings"). No footprint of the building in OpenStreetMap. In 2017 the land held two villas with tile roofs, a tennis court and an empty field (PHOTO f01-f03). In March 2024 the frame was up to about 14 floors on a base of about 5 floors (PHOTO c03, c04): the final number of floors is not known.
sources: PHOTO f01, f02, f03 (2017 aerials titled "40 Quang Trung - Vung Tau")
WEB futuresoutheastasia.com (DoubleTree by Hilton, built by DICcons)

marks.storeys: PHOTO c03 (floors of the frame in 2024)

rows.name: Công viên Bãi Trước (the park of the Front Beach)
rows.ground: a sidewalk of 6 to 8 m under old Terminalia trees, then lawns with coconut palms, frangipani, clipped bushes and sculptures; paths; a walk and a low wall of stone along the beach
rows.notes: The whole side of the sea by the two one-way roads: no building on the street. In the park: a fountain (OSM way 221424404), sculptures (OSM: "Modern Art Sculpture Park"), a playground, two public toilets, small kiosks (a teal kiosk on the sidewalk in 2014), a pavilion with an orange tile roof near the south end, a paved square (OSM way 220617813) and, past the south end, a car park (OSM way 220821617). OpenStreetMap gives the park the address 38 Quang Trung.

rows.name: walk of the sea with strips of lawn
rows.ground: a wide walk of stone slabs, four strips of lawn in low granite borders between the walk and the road, lamps, the low wall and the beach
rows.notes: Across the park Tam Giác, where the street is still one road.
sources: PHOTO c06 (2014: Araucaria trees along the road)
PHOTO d09, d16 (the wall of stone)

rows.name: small beach and paved square at the end of Ba Cu
rows.ground: a paved square that opens on a small beach
rows.notes: OpenStreetMap: natural=beach 220821630 and the square 220617809.

rows.name: walk on the sea wall
rows.ground: a sidewalk of 4 to 5 m of grey and white tiles in a checker pattern, a low wall of concrete, rocks and the sea below (no beach); lamps with five globes; benches
rows.notes: Opposite the lots of Lam Sơn, to the turn into Trần Phú.
sources: OSM way 269739594 (coastline, 18 m from the axis of the road)
